Subject: Vendor setup - PO intake & payment cadence

Hi David,

Thanks for taking our call this morning. Attached are KartelTech's completed PO intake form and W9. We are onboarding to support Redwood's integration work for the Q1 pilot. A few notes on our side:

- We typically operate on a Net60 billing cadence with monthly consolidated invoices.
- For large deployments we can provide consolidated monthly POs and prefer longer terms to align with our collections cycles.

That said, we are open to discussion on payment lanes if Redwood needs different timing. Do you have a standard onboarding netterm for new vendors? Also let me know if you need any further paperwork or bank details.

Attachments: KartelTech_PO_Form.pdf, Vendor_W9.pdf

Best,

Emily,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the forms. A couple of housekeeping items from procurement/finance so we can get KartelTech activated:

1) We need the signed PO intake PDF you attached (looks complete) and confirmation of your remit-to banking details.
2) Redwood's default onboarding payment lane is Net45 for new technology vendors while we complete our vendor verification and PO routing. For strategic partners we can make exceptions, but that requires AP mapping and an early-pay agreement.
3) If you prefer Net60, escalate to finance for approval — it can be done but may delay initial PO creation by a few business days.

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist with the exact fields we need populated for the AP team to create the vendor record. Can you confirm preferred netterm and whether you want to opt into any early-pay program (fee-based)?

Next steps: once we have the completed checklist and remit info, AP will create the vendor in Coupa and route the first PO. Marissa, could you weigh in on early-pay options here? Jordan, tagging you since this impacts billing cadence for the initial engagement.

Thanks,
David
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi all,

Quick note from Finance on early-pay options and netterm flexibility:

- Standard: Net45 (no fee). This is what procurement prefers for new vendors while vendor confirmations complete.
- Early-pay pilot: We can offer a 0.5% fee (deducted from the invoice) to move terms to Net30 for the first 1-2 invoices. Approval required from the account owner for any fee impact to the deal economics.
- Net60 requests: Acceptable for vendor relationships with constrained cash cycles but require AP to set a non-standard payment lane; will add 3-5 business days to vendor activation.

If Jordan is comfortable with a 0.5% early-pay option for onboarding, Finance will: 1) sign the simple early-pay term sheet, 2) enable KartelTech in the early-pay queue, and 3) map PO routing so the initial POs flow to the expedited payout lane.

Emily, please confirm if KartelTech wants to participate in the 0.5% Net30 pilot for the first two invoices. If not, we'll proceed with Net45 and target first payment on that cadence.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

References: early-pay program doc link - https://redwood.app/ds/earlypay/KARTEL-9082

Team —

Thanks for the context. Jordan here (account lead for KartelTech) — decision below so we can avoid further back-and-forth:

1) Set vendor as Net45 for standard onboarding. AP, please create the vendor record and map the PO intake to our integration project code.
2) Approve the early-pay pilot: KartelTech may request early settlement on up to two invoices at onboarding at a 0.5% fee. Finance to enable the early-pay flag and share the simple term sheet.

Marissa: please circulate the signed-earlypay-term-sheet once ready and confirm the expected cutover date for the first PO. David: notify AP to proceed with vendor activation.
